title: Consistency for the rank-one matrix
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. For independent uniform vectors $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the probability that $(\gamma\cdot x)(\gamma\cdot y)=\sum_{i,j=1}^n\gamma_i\gamma_jx_i y_j$ in $\mathbb F_2$ is $1$.
